title: Canon EOS R1 Flagship Sports & Action Stacked Full-Frame
purpose: Elite sports, wildlife, fast action, and decisive-moment photojournalism where capture responsiveness, 40 fps speed, and micro-motion freeze outrank pure pixel count.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Canon EOS R1 Flagship Full-Frame Back-Illuminated Stacked CMOS
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 36x24mm Full-Frame Back-Illuminated Stacked CMOS with Accelerated Capture System
sensor_and_optics.lens: Canon RF 85mm F1.2L USM stopped down to f/2.8 action sweet spot
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 100 base sensor sensitivity (ultra-clean high-ISO up to 102,400)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15+ stops dynamic range with 14-bit RAW processing
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electronic stacked shutter up to 1/64000s and 1/400s high-speed flash sync, zero rolling shutter skew

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: High-speed outdoor arena or natural ambient daylight with fast shutter freeze (1/2000s to 1/8000s), base ISO 100
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: High-contrast dynamic action lighting, crisp rim separation, zero motion blur on fast-moving limbs

surface_rendering: Tack-sharp action detail: athletic sweat beads, muscle striations, fabric tension weave, airborne dirt or water droplets
Accurate skin micro-relief without smearing from high-speed electronic readout
Crisp optical acutance with zero chromatic fringing or digital edge halos
depth_and_optics: Precise subject isolation with fast tracking autofocus on athletes or wildlife
Smooth foreground and background out-of-focus roll-off without synthetic computational blur
Clean rectilinear geometry with zero distortion across edges

render_defects: motion blur when freeze is requested

execution_directive: Enforce Canon EOS R1 decisive-moment sports capture at 1/2000s+ shutter freeze. Eliminate motion blur on action subjects, plastic skin, rolling shutter skew, and synthetic blur.
